desc:
Kart is a stylized desert drink stall on wheels: a leaning wooden wagon with a cactus sign, a sun umbrella, barrels, clay pots and glowing potion bottles, all built as one set piece. It's the kind of prop that gives a town, market or hub area its personality.

The shapes are pushed for readability, with exaggerated planks, chunky wheels and a tilted roof that read from any camera angle. Everything is sculpted first for clean bakes, then packed into a single 4K texture set with distinct material IDs, which keeps draw calls low for a prop this busy. Pivots are set properly, so the pieces can be moved and dressed in engine.

Need hero props or set pieces for a stylized game world? We can match this look, or take it wherever your project needs to go.
software: ZBrush, Maya, Substance Painter, Marmoset Toolbag
